# @vibedgames/gamepad 0.1.3 (vendored)

On-screen touch controls: a floating analog stick and action buttons, plus a reader for
physical controllers. MIT, copyright 2023 Kaiyu Hsu. https://github.com/kyh/vibedgames

Copied from the npm tarball (`gamepad-0.1.3.tgz`, integrity
`sha512-NtPh33z7UACleNdNsk3jSpmJd3fZEyngKahzJNmiNDlpjNE+Cdcd8GqGOA48KfU9gxrs37HGHpEjVZY2t1EFfw==`).
Only `dist/` files the site uses are here (core, dom, safe-area, physical, index), with the
source-map comments removed. The Phaser adapter is left out.

Games don't import this directly: use `lib/touch-controls.mjs`.
